title: Player moves at 230 px/s with a short ramp (supersedes REC-3's 180 px/s)
intent: Make movement responsive enough to dodge the faster late waves, with weight instead of an instant start and stop

evidence.description: speed 180 to 230 with ACCEL_MS 50 and DECEL_MS 35
measured full speed, ramp and diagonal speed

constraints.statement: PLAYER_SPEED is 230 px/s, reached in 50 ms and stopped in 35 ms; the input is normalized first so diagonals also move at 230
Any telegraph timing (src/entities/giantRules.ts) must stay escapable at the current player speed when it changes
